A '''mindspear''' was a type of fiber-photon, [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]]-based biotechnological device that was developed by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and could be used to transfer memories into [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] individuals. At some point, agents of [[One Sith]]&mdash;a resurgent [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]]&mdash;recovered a number of mindspears from Rakatan ruins in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some Sith [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] attempted to replicate the technology, but were unsuccessful, and the spears came to form the basis of a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] program that was initiated by the Sith.

In [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (I)|Darth Wyyrlok]] gave two mindspears to [[Nyss Nenn]], an [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] Sith agent. On Wyyrlok's orders, Nenn awakened an [[Iteration]], a clone of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]], and used a mindspear to transfer some of Korr's memories into the clone. Nenn then placed the Iteration into a [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]] and set off to find the real Korr, planning to use the other mindspear to transfer Korr's consciousness into the Iteration, to allow the clone to replace Korr and infiltrate the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Nenn and the Iteration eventually encountered Korr inside a Rakatan construct in the Unknown Regions and the Iteration immobalized Korr, then transferred the Jedi's consciousness into the mindspear. However, Korr's [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Marr Idi-Shael]] confronted the clone and used the mindspear to transplant Korr's consciousness into the Iteration before the clone was ready to begin the process. The transfer was successful and the Iteration passed out, then re-awoke with Korr's memories inside its mind.
